name: 藕粉厚底系带休闲女鞋款
description: 藕粉海报开场、圆章卖点、尺码规格、上脚场景与微距工艺的厚底女鞋套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: dusty pink #EDC9C5 for poster, badge and closing shots, clean white #FFFFFF for spec, size and variant screens, soft neutral grey #EFECEA for macro details
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key, soft natural contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless dusty-pink paper #EDC9C5 and smooth light-grey studio floor #ECECEC
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #33383D, small vermillion #E2502E accent underlines, bilingual small-caps section labels, thin divider lines
styleLock.iconSystem: solid dried-rose round badges #C48B89 with short white labels, thin divider lines, no complex illustrations
styleLock.presentationRules: pair always shown as a matched left-right pair, stable slight-3/4 hero scale, grounded contact shadows, product never covered by badges or props
styleLock.lockText: consistent soft feminine footwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dusty pink background #EDC9C5, dried-rose components #C48B89, charcoal text #33383D, clean white #FFFFFF and one vermillion accent #E2502E reserved for underlines and small accents; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and soft natural contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with bilingual small-caps section labels and thin divider lines; consistent dried-rose round badge components; clean high-end footwear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with the pair grounded by contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 开场以新品海报氛围一秒建立柔美气质，赢得点击

shots.background: matte seamless dusty pink #EDC9C5 with a thin white poster border frame
shots.textZone: top-right short headline block 「{callout_1}」 in #33383D with one small vermillion #E2502E accent underline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce new-arrival hero poster of {product}, a matched left-right pair overlapping diagonally. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, toes pointing toward the lower left. Bright soft diffused studio light with a gentle front-left key, soft natural contact shadows grounding the pair. Matte seamless dusty pink backdrop #EDC9C5 with a thin #FFFFFF border frame around the poster edge. Top-right a short headline block in #33383D reads 「{callout_1}」 with one small vermillion #E2502E accent underline beneath it. Negative: no brand logo, no readable brand text, no English slogan filler, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 从 7 张爆款厚底系带女鞋详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌英文字标（含实拍区品牌字）、会员促销条与二维码、全部原文案（上新标题、圆章卖点词、工艺小标题等统一转为 {selling_point}/{callout} 短句槽位由商家回填）、尺码实测数值与鞋材成分声明（同走槽位，材质交由 {product_identity_lock} 注入）；街拍镜头仅保留脚部角色，不带入任何模特身份；产品一律以 {product} 占位，鞋身标识由 {product_identity_lock} 锁定为用户产品。
